title: [BUG] Super minor capitalisation discrepancy in `help` output
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [x] Other: <!-- specify --> Ubuntu desktop
- Claude CLI version: <!-- output of `claude --version` --> 0.2.105 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: <!-- e.g. macOS 14.3, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04 --> Ubuntu 25.04
- Terminal:  <!-- e.g. iTerm2, Terminal App --> Gnome Terminal

## Bug Description
The "display help for command" in `-h`, `--help` or `claude help` appears as "display help for command" and not "Display help for command". All other options have a Capitalised first letter.

## Steps to Reproduce
```
$ claude --help
...
  -c, --continue                  Continue the most recent conversation
  -r, --resume [sessionId]        Resume a conversation - provide a session ID or interactively select a conversation to resume
  -h, --help                      display help for command
...
```

or

```
$ claude mcp help
....
  reset-project-choices                          Reset all approved and rejected project-scoped (.mcp.json) servers within this project
  help [command]                                 display help for command
...
```

## Expected Behavior
Capital 'D'

## Actual Behavior
Lower case `d`

## Additional Context

This is beyond minor but...also maybe trivial to fix :)
author: mattgodbolt
